added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite arms. baseline_suite at 5e0d75eb5 and after_suite at 25ba64112 (the code commit; the reviewed head 049ef4f47 adds only a fragment line and is code-identical) both end `==== 4 failed, 1728 passed, 357 deselected` and `==== 4 failed, 1732 passed, 357 deselected` respectively with a bare EXIT=1, and carry the identical four failing ids: tests/graph/test_dd_aux_streaming.py::test_embed_identifier_schemas_emits_items, tests/graph/test_dd_aux_streaming.py::test_embed_ids_nodes_emits_items, tests/graph/test_vector_quantization.py::TestDimensionMismatchDetection::test_drops_index_with_wrong_dimension, tests/graph/test_vector_quantization.py::TestDimensionMismatchDetection::test_drops_multiple_mismatched_indexes. Head-minus-base added failures = 0 with no ids.

findings.text: follow-on: the created count is pinned by a fake session that emulates MERGE/ON CREATE SET and the new RETURN aggregate; the Cypher is only EXPLAIN-verified, so the database's own behaviour of the mark-then-REMOVE-then-sum statement (and that a second create-only MERGE of the same rows reports 0) is never executed. A `-m graph` test that runs the create-only write twice and reads created 1 then 0 would exercise Neo4j's semantics rather than a local model of them, which is where the sibling seed-fix review also drew its line.

item_verdicts.diff: 46 lines in client.py (create-only node_query becomes MERGE with ON CREATE SET n += item, n._created_by_merge = true, WITH the mark, REMOVE it and RETURN sum(CASE...); empty list returns created=0; the loop reads result.single() and accumulates), 14 in frontier.py (reads ["created"], sums canonical and alias, returns created), and the two test files gain a _Result.double and three create-only/seed assertions.
item_verdicts.done_when: the create-only write reports nodes created, the seed returns that count, and a test seeds two existing roots plus one new root and expects 1 while the default create_nodes count is unchanged; the declared negative control (created replaced by processed) fails; the focused gate is green and the gate shows no failure beyond the four that fail at base. All present.
item_verdicts.goal: §14's seed-count node makes the create-only branch of GraphClient.create_nodes report how many nodes it created, and seed_facility_roots return that count for its canonical and alias rows, so --add-roots stops printing every configured root as added; implemented at 049ef4f47.
item_verdicts.manifest: present and self-consistent: status complete, commits 049ef4f47/25ba64112/4c6da9acb/05854ed70, changed_paths matching the diff, gate logs named, and the negative-control note naming the checked mutation; its baseline_suite and after_suite arms carry the four pre-existing ids on both sides.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff 5e0d75eb5..049ef4f47 touches exactly five paths — imas_codex/graph/client.py, imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py, tests/graph/test_create_nodes_create_only.py, tests/discovery/test_seed_existing_roots.py and the evidence fragment — all within the declared scope; the granted figures directory is untouched and the reviewed worktree is clean.

justifications.durability: the mark is cleared in the same statement it is set, so no `_created_by_merge` property can persist, and the default upsert path is byte-identical in behaviour and reports no new key, so no existing caller changes; the count is now correct for every caller of the seed, which is what retires the prior review's reporting follow-on.
justifications.evidence: I copied the reviewed head into $TMPDIR and reran the focused suite — 11 passed (EXIT=0) — and independently applied the declared mutation (created <- processed) to a second copy: test_seed_reports_only_created_roots then fails at `assert 3 == 1`, EXIT=1, so the guard fires. The head gate reads 4 failed/1732 passed and the base gate 4 failed/1728 passed with the same four ids, so added failures are 0. Two deductions: the head gate header names the code commit 25ba64112 rather than the reviewed head 049ef4f47 (they are code-identical — the head adds only a fragment line), and the created-count semantics rest on a fake session's model of MERGE/ON CREATE SET plus an EXPLAIN of the Cypher, not on a live-graph execution.
justifications.fit: four conventional commits, each with a body stating what changed and why; no AI attribution and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier or phase name in subjects, bodies, symbol names, filenames or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every clause holds — create_only reports created (client.py:674-750), seed_facility_roots returns it for canonical and alias rows (frontier.py:565-593), test_create_only_reports_created_count seeds two existing plus one new and asserts created==1 while processed==3, test_default_reports_processed_and_no_created_count asserts the key is absent under the default, and test_seed_reports_only_created_roots drives the seed to 1.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing create_nodes owner with a returned count and reuses the codebase's ON CREATE SET idiom rather than adding an abstraction; the marker-and-REMOVE technique is the minimum needed to recover a created count from MERGE.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is confined to the five declared paths, deletes nothing, and leaves the reviewed worktree clean.
